mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.MEMBER_ID, O.RECEIVER_ID, O.PRODUCT_ID, O.QUANTITY, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.ADDRESS, O.DETAIL_ADDRESS, O.PAYMENT_METHOD, O.ORDER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ORDER_DATE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY FROM ORDERS O JOIN PRODUCT P ON O.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.MEMBER_ID, O.RECEIVER_ID, O.PRODUCT_ID, O.QUANTITY, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.ADDRESS, O.DETAIL_ADDRESS, O.PAYMENT_METHOD, O.ORDER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ORDER_DATE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY FROM ORDERS O JOIN PRODUCT P ON O.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.RECEIVER_ID = #{receiverId} ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.MEMBER_ID, O.RECEIVER_ID, O.PRODUCT_ID, O.QUANTITY, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.ADDRESS, O.DETAIL_ADDRESS, O.PAYMENT_METHOD, O.ORDER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(O.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ORDER_DATE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY FROM ORDERS O JOIN PRODUCT P ON O.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( MEMBER_ID, RECEIVER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QUANTITY, TOTAL_PRICE, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDRESS, PAYMENT_METHOD, ORDER_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{receiverId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{paymentMethod}, '주문완료' )
